name: Haydan
bio: I build scalable Single Page Applications with React and power them using high-performance Python FastAPI backends. Passionate about decoupled architecture, real-time systems, and bare-metal deployments.
about: I'm a Python Full-Stack Developer specializing in bridging dynamic React frontends with high-performance FastAPI backends. My engineering focus is on decoupled architectures, real-time communication (WebSockets/WebRTC), and scalable database management using MongoDB and MySQL. From crafting responsive UIs to self-hosting infrastructure on bare-metal Ubuntu servers, I thrive on handling the complete data flow and building systems that solve real-world problems.

projects.title: Hamnasheen
projects.description: A secure, private messaging and calling application built for exclusive family communication. Features include real-time P2P audio/video, strict MVC architecture, and bare-metal deployment on a local Ubuntu server.

projects.title: Auto News Scraper
projects.description: A Python-based automation script that scrapes the latest headlines from Hacker News and dynamically generates a responsive, dark-themed HTML interface, opening it directly in the browser.

projects.title: AI Terminal Assistant
projects.description: An AI-powered terminal wrapper that catches failed commands before the system crashes and instantly queries the Gemini AI to provide human-readable, step-by-step solutions right in the workspace.

projects.title: API Gateway Kit
projects.description: Lightweight API gateway with rate limiting, JWT authentication, request logging, and OpenAPI documentation generation.

projects.title: Portfolio CMS
projects.description: Headless CMS for developers to manage portfolio content via JSON schemas, with instant static site generation.
